title: Frontend A-Z Deep QA with Ops Workflows + Isolation

suite_groups.label: Shipment lifecycle
suite_groups.workflow: Add shipment, fill details, update status, verify list/detail parity

suite_groups.label: Label lifecycle
suite_groups.workflow: Download/print labels, verify bulk actions, update label design

suite_groups.label: Workflow admin lifecycle
suite_groups.workflow: Create/edit/remove workflow templates and validate request/run linkage

suite_groups.label: Profile/settings and persistence
suite_groups.workflow: Persist per-user preferences and settings/access request submission

suite_groups.workflow: Scope-aware data visibility and cross-tenant isolation checks

suite_groups.label: Permission isolation
suite_groups.workflow: Capability-gated UI controls and denied action safety

scenarios.title: Create shipment and persist required details
steps: Open shipment resource workflow entry
Create shipment with tagged reference prefix E2E-AZ-<runId>
Populate required operational fields and save
Reload route and open detail drawer/page
expected_results: Record exists after refresh
List row and detail view show consistent values
No duplicate submission on rapid-click

scenarios.title: Status transitions and failure recovery
preconditions: Seeded or newly created shipment exists
steps: Attempt allowed status transition
Attempt denied/invalid transition
Trigger retry path after simulated transient failure
expected_results: Allowed transition reflected in list and detail
Denied transition surfaces actionable message
Retry is idempotent and does not duplicate mutation

scenarios.title: Authenticated amend/cancel workflow stays policy-backed and engine-backed
preconditions: Shipment amend/cancel operation routes reachable for console and portal
Seeded shipment exists both inside and outside the configured cancel window
steps: Open shipment amend/cancel route with an allowed shipment_id
Submit one soft-cancel mutation through the authenticated operation form
Open shipment amend/cancel route with a blocked shipment_id
expected_results: Allowed shipment completes one soft-cancel path without duplicate submission
Blocked shipment stays disabled with a policy-derived reason
Console and portal surfaces both render the same workflow-backed contract
expected_backend_calls: canonical shipment workflow templates via start_workflow_run/progress_workflow_run

scenarios.title: Concurrent shipment edits across sessions
preconditions: Same shipment opened in two sessions
steps: Session A updates shipment details and saves
Session B attempts conflicting update or status transition
Use retry/refresh control from Session B conflict response
expected_results: Conflict error is deterministic and actionable
No silent overwrite of Session A changes
Refresh/retry path restores backend truth in list and detail

scenarios.title: One-click print from shipment row triggers workflow and auto-download
steps: Click Print labels once from shipments list selection bar
Observe workflow request trigger response
Wait for auto-download to start without manual workflow run navigation
expected_results: Workflow run starts via ui_execute_command_v1
Signed output URL is discovered and trusted before opening
Download starts automatically from row context

scenarios.title: One-click print from shipment detail uses the same execution path
preconditions: Shipment detail view opened from list row
steps: Invoke print action from shipment detail action panel
Observe workflow trigger and auto-download behavior
expected_results: Detail action triggers same command/RPC path as row action
Auto-download behavior matches row context
No duplicate workflow run for a single click

scenarios.title: Bulk one-click print produces workflow output for selected shipments
steps: Click Print labels once with multi-row selection
Verify workflow payload includes selected IDs
Observe bundle/parallel downloads when outputs are ready
expected_results: Single workflow run includes complete selection set
Bulk print respects selection constraints and permissions
Output availability reflected without manual run lookup

scenarios.title: One-click print timeout falls back to run outputs page
preconditions: Workflow output generation delayed past poll timeout
steps: Click Print labels once
Allow polling window to expire without output URL
expected_results: App navigates automatically to workflow run outputs route
Toast/message explains fallback and next action
No false success state is shown

scenarios.title: Update label design and verify downstream availability
steps: Open label designer
Apply design changes and submit
Verify updated label behavior in shipment workflow
expected_results: Design change request/workflow recorded
Downstream label actions remain functional
Permission-denied users cannot mutate design

scenarios.title: Create/edit/remove workflow template
steps: Create new workflow template draft
Edit steps/triggers
Archive/remove template
Check requests/runs screens
expected_results: Template lifecycle actions persist correctly
Removed/archived templates are no longer action-ready
Workflow requests/runs reflect lifecycle changes

scenarios.title: Preference persistence and user isolation
preconditions: Two users with same app access available
steps: User A changes sidebar/section preferences
Sign out and sign in as User B
Validate User B does not inherit User A preferences
Return to User A and validate persistence
expected_results: Preferences persist per user
No cross-user preference bleed

scenarios.title: Settings/access request submission visibility
preconditions: At least one requester-capable user and one non-requester user
steps: Submit settings request with requester user
Open same flow with non-requester user
expected_results: Requester sees submission success path
Non-requester sees blocked/denied state with rationale

scenarios.title: Tenant data isolation across roles/scopes
preconditions: Users provisioned for platform, tenant, client, sender scopes
steps: Run equivalent navigation/resource flows with each scoped user
Attempt direct URL to foreign scope data
expected_results: Scope-resolved data visibility only
Foreign-scope direct URL denied/blocked/not-found-safe
No sensitive data leakage in UI state

scenarios.title: Cross-tenant direct URL attempt is denied safely
preconditions: Known resource ID from tenant A
steps: Authenticate as tenant B user
Open direct URL to tenant A resource route
Attempt action invocation if route renders shell
expected_results: Denied/blocked/not-found-safe response only
No tenant A data values rendered
Unauthorized action call does not succeed

scenarios.title: Capability isolation on view/action controls
preconditions: Users with and without settings/access capabilities
steps: Open view management/access policy surfaces with both user types
Attempt privileged actions
expected_results: Privileged controls visible only for authorized users
Unauthorized actions blocked and clearly messaged
